oncall-bot: PAGER -> billing_ops: detected emitter divergence: usage-emitter-eu1 token count drift >12% vs shadow. auto-severity: high :rotating_light:
sara: on it, joining the thread
miguel: I'm the oncall for billing this shift, taking lead. what's the observed window?
billing-analytics: quick snapshot:
`````
emitter: usage-emitter-eu1
window: 2025-03-10T12:00Z - 2025-03-10T12:15Z
reported_tokens: 1,234,567
shadow_tokens: 1,407,890
delta: -12.3%
overage_flags: 42 -> 128
consumer_lag_ms: 120000
`````
priya: CS pinged us about a customer alert (small account). they reported a sudden overage email. no confirmed charge yet.
miguel: initial hunch: short-lived consumer lag + duplicate-suppression flag flip on the emitter. that combo can undercount then later replay and spike flags
sara: can we mute external overage notifications while we triage? we should avoid spamming customers if it's internal telemetry noise
dan: +1 to mute for 30m, set internal note. I'll trigger the alert-mute playbook (billing-alerts.mute 30m)
miguel: plan: 1) run targeted backfill for that emitter 2) recompute flags for affected windows 3) reconcile diffs and unmute
billing-analytics: command to run: `./backfill --emitter=usage-emitter-eu1 --since=2025-03-10T11:50Z --mode=diff-only`
miguel: kicking off backfill now, monitoring logs. ETA ~8m
priya: CS: message draft -> "We’re investigating a temporary billing visibility issue for some EU customers. No confirmed overcharges. We will update within ~30 minutes." @cs-team
sara: adding a short public status note to status.redwooding (internal) to reduce incoming tickets
miguel: observed logs: kafka consumer restarted at 12:02:13Z, processed backlog, then emitter duplicate-suppression toggled at 12:05:01Z. suspect race during restart
billing-analytics: backfill running, current progress 45% (approx 4m)
dan: also creating INC ticket: INC-2025-042 (billing emitter divergence) and assigning to miguel
miguel: backfill finished. kicking recompute stitch job: `./stitch --emitter usage-emitter-eu1 --window 2025-03-10T12:00Z/2025-03-10T12:15Z`
billing-analytics: recompute complete: new stats:
`````
reported_tokens: 1,397,820
shadow_tokens: 1,407,890
delta: -0.72%
overage_flags: 47 -> 48 (after recompute)
`````
miguel: diffs narrowed to <1%, no confirmed billing delta. lowering severity. preparing reconciliation run to ensure no downstream invoices will be affected
sara: great. please leave a CS note and unmute customer alerts only after final reconcile.
priya: CS notified with update, they will hold customer communications until final signoff
dan: action items logged in INC-2025-042: autoscale consumer, add alert when emitter-shadow divergence >5%, add mute-playbook checklist. owner: dan + miguel
miguel: marking pager resolved locally. follow-up: postmortem to capture race-condition fix and safer flag toggles
oncall-bot: Pager resolved (duration 00:32).
